title: Climate Change Act 2021 (Act of Tynwald, AT 20 of 2021)
citation: Climate Change Act 2021 (AT 20 of 2021), Royal Assent 15 December 2021 per the Isle of Man Government
evidence: Isle of Man Government news page, 15 December 2021 (opened 2026-11-10): "The Climate Change Act 2021 sets the legal framework for planning, monitoring and reporting the reduction of greenhouse gas emissions needed to reach net zero." and "Now the Bill has received Royal Assent it has become an Act of Tynwald." The page states no commencement date for the Act as a whole (it says a five year rolling action plan should come into effect by 1 April 2022).
notes: Link only: row IM-LEGISLATION-ADOPTED is permission requested because legislation.gov.im and the gov.im terms page could not be opened (WAF rejection), and tynwald.org.im answers HTTP 403. The citation AT 20 of 2021 and the net zero 2050 target (s.9) come from the FAOLEX copy of the Tynwald print (https://faolex.fao.org/docs/pdf/uk214391.pdf), a UN host that is not an official source and is used only to find the title and number; in_force is null because no official page opened states a commencement date. No Order extending a UK Act is involved.
status_note: Official text not opened; row not pass.
